properties.name: game_state reflects the authoritative game
properties.expression: GameState reports the current board, territory owner, per-seat controller, team, territory, losses with the per-capturer bowl, score and resignation, team totals, pending merge proposals, seat to move, move number, remaining time and, from since_move on, every move record with victims and bot search summaries; winners are the seats of the team or teams with the highest team score that still have a member who has not resigned

properties.name: Lab-style viewer
properties.expression: The browser presents the N-Player Go Lab experience against server state: board with Wall coordinates, territory squares, last-move and next-move markers; Home/Back/Forward/End and previous/next variation by buttons and arrow keys; a variation tree and next-move chips; a Search panel listing the viewed position's candidates (visit share and reward) with a heat overlay; per-seat Territory, Bowl, Score, Proj. and Outlook and team totals; a clickable projected-score timeline; GIF export of the viewed line; stone, capture and final-ten-seconds sounds with a toggle; it follows live moves while the viewer is at the latest move and otherwise shows that new moves arrived
properties.formula: AG atom("The browser presents the N-Player Go Lab experience against server state: board with Wall coordinates, territory squares, last-move and next-move markers; Home/Back/Forward/End and previous/next variation by buttons and arrow keys; a variation tree and next-move chips; a Search panel listing the viewed position's candidates (visit share and reward) with a heat overlay; per-seat Territory, Bowl, Score, Proj. and Outlook and team totals; a clickable projected-score timeline; GIF export of the viewed line; stone, capture and final-ten-seconds sounds with a toggle; it follows live moves while the viewer is at the latest move and otherwise shows that new moves arrived")

properties.name: Analysis is local
properties.expression: Variations and local Monte Carlo searches run in the viewer's browser on a copy of the position, are never sent to the server, never change the game, and are lost when the page closes; watchers may branch and search at any time; seated people may browse the actual moves during play and may branch and search once the game has finished
properties.formula: AG atom("Variations and local Monte Carlo searches run in the viewer's browser on a copy of the position, are never sent to the server, never change the game, and are lost when the page closes; watchers may branch and search at any time; seated people may browse the actual moves during play and may branch and search once the game has finished")
